desc: Prove the noncrossing-pairing structure and the odd-position survivor decomposition into independent even left/right segments.
Prove an even segment’s optimum is the sum of its larger half minus the sum of its smaller half.
Implement prefix/suffix even-segment statistics in `O(N log N)` with heaps and 64-bit arithmetic.
Combine valid odd survivor splits, handle even `N` directly, and validate samples plus edge cases.
